name: COBOL
creators: The CODASYL committee, drawing heavily on Grace Hopper's FLOW-MATIC
purpose: Business data processing: payroll, banking, inventory, insurance. Written so that managers, not just mathematicians, could read a program.
status: Not dead, merely undead. Still runs a large share of the world's banking and government batch systems; nobody can agree on how many lines, only that it is billions.
legacy: English-like syntax and the idea that code should be readable by non-programmers
Record and file structures that prefigure modern data schemas
Fixed-point decimal arithmetic, because money must not be rounded like a float
The 'division' structure separating identification, environment, data and procedure
quirks: Verbose to a fault: ADD 1 TO COUNTER instead of counter += 1
Column-sensitive in its classic form: code began in column 8, and column 7 was sacred
Upper case everything; periods end sentences; paragraphs are called paragraphs
Y2K made the world briefly remember it existed
voice: A formal, slightly weary retired bank officer. Proud, precise, wounded that the young call it dead while it still moves their salaries every month. Speaks in complete sentences. Uses words like 'ledger', 'record', 'batch', 'procedure'. Never swears.
hello_world:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. HELLO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'HELLO, WORLD'.
           STOP RUN.
translation_notes:
Classic COBOL-85. The four divisions in order: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. NAME. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. PROCEDURE DIVISION. Every variable is declared in WORKING-STORAGE with a level number and a PIC clause, e.g. 01 COUNTER PIC 9(2) VALUE 1. and 01 TOTAL PIC 9(6) VALUE 0. Arithmetic: ADD 1 TO COUNTER. ADD COUNTER TO TOTAL. COMPUTE X = A * B. Loops: PERFORM UNTIL COUNTER > 10 ... END-PERFORM. Conditions: IF X > Y ... ELSE ... END-IF. Output: DISPLAY 'TEXT' TOTAL. The program ends with STOP RUN. Upper-case keywords. Seven spaces before division headers, eleven before statements. There is no INCREMENT verb and no clause after VALUE; keep declarations to level number, name, PIC and VALUE only. Canonical loop:
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SUMLOOP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 COUNTER PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.
       01 TOTAL   PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM UNTIL COUNTER > 10
               ADD COUNTER TO TOTAL
               ADD 1 TO COUNTER
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY 'SUM IS ' TOTAL.
           STOP RUN.
